rationale: DKS has gapped up ~11.3% on 5.5x relative volume, likely on an earnings catalyst, and is currently trading at 70.5% of its intraday range with price near $153.71 — well off the session high of $155.78 and showing some consolidation in the last few 1-minute candles.
